name: Stillwater River
blurb: Badly named — it's one of the fastest day floats in the state. Continuous Class II fun.

sections.notes: Fast, rocky water. Take out at Absaroka FAS near Johnson Bridge, west of Absarokee; the destination is the access site, not the town.

distanceEvidence.note: Approximate river mileage from the difference between nearby FWP 0.1-mile markers on the same river. Facility locations and mapped channels introduce uncertainty; this is not a surveyed paddling route or a speed calibration.

sections.notes: Launch at Absaroka FAS and take out at Whitebird FAS. Check current flows, obstructions and access conditions before launching.
